comparison.command:
setsid --fork --wait nohup python3 scripts/s11c_guarded_run.py --pool mouth-drift-volume-compare --memory-gib 1 --log-directory _scratch/s11c/mouth_drift_lateral_series16_01 -- python3 -c 'import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

prior, latest = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
runs = [r for r in json.loads(prior.read_text())['"'"'runs'"'"'] if r['"'"'normal_cells'"'"']==32 and r['"'"'cells'"'"'] in (8,12)]
outcome = json.loads((latest/'"'"'outcome.json'"'"').read_text())
if outcome['"'"'exitCode'"'"'] or outcome['"'"'childOutcome'"'"']['"'"'exitCode'"'"'] or not outcome['"'"'limitsVerified'"'"']:
    raise ValueError('"'"'Unsuccessful new volume run'"'"')
runs.append(dict(cells=16, normal_cells=32, stdout=(latest/'"'"'stdout'"'"').read_text().splitlines()))
if sorted(r['"'"'cells'"'"'] for r in runs)!=[8,12,16]:
    raise ValueError('"'"'Incomplete lateral series'"'"')
previous = None
for row in sorted(runs,key=lambda v:v['"'"'cells'"'"']):
    data = [dict(w.split('"'"'='"'"') for w in line.split()) for line in row['"'"'stdout'"'"']]
    grid, = [r for r in data if '"'"'cells'"'"' in r]
    if (int(grid['"'"'cells'"'"']),int(grid['"'"'normal_cells'"'"']))!=(row['"'"'cells'"'"'],32):
        raise ValueError('"'"'Mismatched preparation'"'"')
    old, = [r for r in data if '"'"'archived_boundary'"'"' in r]
    four = [r for r in data if r.get('"'"'order'"'"')=='"'"'4'"'"']
    two = [r for r in data if r.get('"'"'order'"'"')=='"'"'2'"'"']
    for stencil in (four,two):
        if sorted(int(r['"'"'reach'"'"']) for r in stencil)!=[2,4,8]:
            raise ValueError('"'"'Incomplete cylinder series'"'"')
    center, = [r for r in four if r['"'"'reach'"'"']=='"'"'4'"'"']
    center2, = [r for r in two if r['"'"'reach'"'"']=='"'"'4'"'"']
    inferred = [float(r['"'"'exterior'"'"']) for r in four]
    corrected = [float(r['"'"'exterior_corrected'"'"']) for r in four]
    residual = float(center['"'"'exterior'"'"'])
    closure = max(abs(float(r['"'"'closure'"'"'])) for r in four+two)
    print(f"cells={row['"'"'cells'"'"']} normal=32 reach=4 exterior={residual:.12g} "
          f"corrected4={center['"'"'exterior_corrected'"'"']} corrected2={center2['"'"'exterior_corrected'"'"']} "
          f"mouth={old['"'"'archived_boundary'"'"']} whole_face={old['"'"'archived_whole'"'"']} "
          f"radii_min={min(inferred):.12g} radii_max={max(inferred):.12g} "
          f"corrected_spread={max(corrected)-min(corrected):.12g} max_closure={closure:.12g} "
          f"ppm_of_storage={1e6*abs(residual/float(center['"'"'storage'"'"'])):.12g}")
    if previous is not None:
        print(f"from={previous[0]} to={row['"'"'cells'"'"']} exterior_change={residual-previous[1]:.12g} "
              f"magnitude_ratio={abs(residual/previous[1]):.12g}")
    previous = (row['"'"'cells'"'"'],residual)
' docs/_measurements/mouth_drift_volume_balance.json _scratch/s11c/mouth_drift_volume_c16_z32_01
